items.exampleEn: Don't judge people by their clothes.
There is a hole in my shirt.
The cat hides under the bed.
I feed my cat every morning.
The cat can jump very high.

items.sentenceEn: The baby likes to touch my face.

items.audioEn: The kids jump into the pool and swim.
items.audioZh: 孩子們跳進游泳池游泳。

items.sentenceEn: We climb the hill every Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們每個星期天爬山丘。

items.sentenceEn: We keep in touch by email.
items.sentenceZh: 我們用電子郵件保持聯絡。

items.stemEn: The children ____ behind the door. Can you find them?
items.stemZh: 孩子們躲在門後面，你找得到他們嗎？

items.stemEn: The wind ____ the leaves around the yard.
items.stemZh: 風把葉子吹得滿院子都是。

items.passageEn: On the farm, my uncle feeds the chickens every morning. One small yellow chicken likes to hide in a dark hole under the house. When the wind blows, it jumps out and runs. My little brother says it is a bad chicken. My uncle says, "Don't judge the chicken. It is just shy!"
items.passageZh: 在農場上，我叔叔每天早上餵雞。有一隻黃色的小雞喜歡躲在房子下面一個暗暗的洞裡。風一吹，牠就跳出來跑掉。我弟弟說牠是一隻壞雞。叔叔說：「不要這樣評斷這隻雞，牠只是比較害羞！」

questions.questionZh: 那隻小雞喜歡躲在哪裡？

rubricZh: 「保持聯絡」用 keep in touch 或 stay in touch

items.instructionZh: 用 jump 造一個句子，說說誰（或什麼動物）會跳。
referenceEn: My dog can jump very high.
The kids jump into the pool.
rubricZh: jump 可接 into、over、on 等表示方向（例如 jump into the pool）
